audit.whatIsWrong: Rated 'Even, 6/10' on a 57.98% win rate over 721 games where the packet chart gives Gangplank everything from Levels 4-5 onward.
audit.why: This is one of Gangplank's best lanes in the slice and the page told the player it was a coin flip.
audit.corrected: diff FAV, tone green, diffRating 4/10, breakdown.difficulty and report[14] realigned.

audit.whatIsWrong: Both charts were wrong at five rows and inverted at both ends: Levels 1-2 given to Gangplank when the content says 'Mel owns these first levels', and Levels 4-5 and Level 6 called 'Skill' when the content says that is exactly where it flips ('Once your kegs are online you chain a barrel onto an escapeless Mel').
audit.why: It told the player to fight in the two levels he loses and to hold back in the stage he wins.
audit.corrected: win[0..4] and phases[0..4].side/.rating/.why brought onto the packet chart as one atomic group.

audit.whatIsWrong: The full layer carries no numbers and never mentions Rebuttal, which the mirror audit identified as the decisive interaction: it reflects Parrrley (a projectile) back at you, and it is a 38/35/33/29/26s cooldown — the longest basic ability in the lane. Solar Snare's own numbers (11s at rank 1, 1000 range, roots at the centre) are absent, and Golden Eclipse is never described as the global Overwhelm execute it is.
audit.why: A 38-second Rebuttal is the single biggest punish window on Mel's bar, and nothing on the full layer told the player it existed or that his Q is the half that gets reflected.
audit.corrected: breakdown.cooldowns, report[5], tldr, winCon, tradeBad, breakdown.trading, report[3] and dontsFull[2] rebuilt around Rebuttal's 38s, Solar Snare's 11s/1000 and Golden Eclipse's 120s global execute.

audit.whatIsWrong: Mel is 'he'/'his' throughout the full layer — tldr, winCon, tradeGood, dontsFull[0], breakdown.wave, breakdown.mid, breakdown.feeding, breakdown.late and report[12].
audit.why: Template carry-over; the content layer has it right.

notes: The content layer here was already the strongest in the slice (the mirror audit had fixed the Rebuttal-vs-Parrrley reflect and the 'Rebuttal-cleanse' naming error). Nearly all of the remaining damage was in the full layer: no cooldown numbers anywhere, Rebuttal never mentioned despite being a 38-second window, and Mel referred to as 'he' in nine places. The missing-interactions file claims Rebuttal 'cuts your retreat' via a terrain flag, but Riot's description says it is a barrier around herself that reflects projectiles and prevents damage — no terrain — so I made no retreat-cutting claim. packet.suspectNames flagged 'Powder Kegs': false positive.
